title: Retries without Duplicate Orders
subtitle: A lost response triggers a retry. Compare creating twice with reusing an idempotency key.

messages.label: POST /orders; key=abc
messages.title: Create an order
messages.text: The client chooses one stable key for this purchase.

messages.label: insert order 101
messages.title: Commit the purchase
messages.text: The store commits the order before the response reaches the client.

messages.label: 201 Created
messages.title: The response is lost
messages.text: The client cannot tell whether the purchase succeeded.

messages.label: POST /orders; key=abc
messages.title: Retry the same purchase
messages.text: A timeout is not proof that the server did nothing.

messages.label: insert order 102
messages.title: Duplicate purchase
messages.text: Without deduplication, the retry creates a second order.

messages.label: 201; order 102
messages.title: Two orders for one intent
messages.text: The customer may now be charged twice.

messages.label: lookup key=abc
messages.title: Reuse the committed result
messages.text: A unique idempotency key is stored atomically with the order.

messages.label: 201; order 101
messages.title: One order, repeatable response
messages.text: The same key returns the original result. The request payload must match.
